decoded.meaning: POINT{ NAME "temp", SETTINGS{}, NAME "doc", VALUE <intent document> } — the RFC-0010 Amendment 5 `:schema` of a vertex with an intent document and no field table: the document sits at the POINT level after the protocol part, and no owner part follows
decoded.note: bytes emitted by the libtracer reference implementation (read_schema on a vertex named `temp` after graph_t::set_intent_document, with no field descriptor table installed); the VALUE is the installed document verbatim
